digest.component_or_area: Snapshot store janitor and cache accounting
propositions: The ADR-promised byte-total backstop trigger for eviction is unimplemented in _gc_pass, which reads only free space and mtime but never consults the incrementally-maintained byte_total counter.
materialize_tickets bypasses cache.acquire and populates entries directly via os.rename without calling add_bytes, leaving ~620 MiB tickets entries unaccounted in the store's byte total.

With both gaps present, the snapshot store has no working size-based reclaim mechanism; the free-space trigger is unreachable below 93.3% disk usage on production, causing disk pressure to breach 85-90%.
The fix implements max_bytes tunable (defaulting to off) with LRU eviction driven by byte_total, and adds add_bytes calls in materialize_tickets to account populated entries exactly once.
